notes: Fixed: removing duplicates now actually saves. The playlist branch called PL._persist, which playlists.js does not export — optional chaining swallowed the call, so the cleanup lived in memory only and duplicates came back on restart. Scrolling no longer stutters: cover art was being re-scanned across every mounted row on each re-slice; it is now deferred and coalesced off the scroll path. Download counts only count what will actually be attempted — already-local and known-unavailable tracks are excluded and reported separately. After a batch, tracks the source refuses for good can be removed on confirmation. Newly downloaded tracks reappear immediately instead of staying hidden until the next restart. Online tracks now carry an icon instead of a text badge, with a distinct colour for unavailable ones. Adding by URL offers to download right away. Playlist Refresh re-fetches titles from the source instead of only rereading the local cache, and a followed playlist can be checked for new tracks on its own.
